name: Fall 2026

reviewed.ratingText: Never, Please No More Like This Ever
reviewed.review: All right, so we’ve gone from starting this season’s reviews, and the first one is a terrible VRMMORPG where you can’t log out, but then you can die and it matters, but it also seems like it doesn’t matter. I don’t know if the concept is here, but the main guy appeared to be kind of a turd who was in the middle of some quest and tried to screw it over for VR… I’m not watching more of this.

So from hearing others, this is a manga that I didn’t read, but it’s like 20 years old, something like that, and it’s based around telephone cards, which were the way that everybody communicated and used very extensively in the 90s through the mid 2000s. I think they did a good job of taking it and moving it forward, making it an even weirder thing. The other thing I’m getting the vibe of is I would call it a semi-nostalgia show from the era where the manga was made, so I definitely get these big 2005 vibes from the character design, art styling, production, etc. Doesn’t hurt that Satelight is the primary anime studio doing this. So overall, I’m curious to see where the episodes go, and hopefully they picked it up as an anime project from a long forgotten manga because the manga is good, and hopefully the anime will be good too.

reviewed.titleEN: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
reviewed.ratingText: Never, Please No More Like This Ever
reviewed.review: Well, this title already has me terrified. Production values are fine, but they did give the main character, who is the witch, the crossed bangs that are traditionally reserved for the shonen boy protagonist. I guess the best thing is that within the first five minutes they did get to the crux of the title of the show: the knight that the witch has a crush on came and asked for a love potion, and then they played the opening. Definitely just a stupid show, will not watch.

reviewed.titleEN: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
reviewed.review: So, big exhale to start this show off, based on the title. Let’s go with the positive: they took the reincarnated-into-a-VRMMORPG premise and moved it from the high fantasy setting and put it in space. Everything else about this show is terrible, but if you watch the opening and you like it, then that’s probably why that’s the opening. So this is definitely the worst show of the season… thus far.

reviewed.ratingText: Never, Please No More Like This Ever
reviewed.review: So this guy literally got divorced from his wife because she accused him of hiding things, because he likes cute stuff and couldn’t acknowledge that. And now he’s living a great life and is totally fine, but he’s still completely hiding it from everyone and himself. It makes this main character, who’s supposed to be kind of a nice, charming fuddy-duddy ojisan type, very unlikable, because he is not honest with himself and destroyed his marriage for no reason. But I’m probably overanalyzing this show, and this is definitely all the time I’m gonna spend on it.

reviewed.titleEN: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
reviewed.review: So now I’m not sure if the other show that I said was the worst of this season is the worst, or if this one is. This one is definitely the worst drawn, animated, whatever one. It’s super low budget, super low quality, super low imagination. I guess the only thing it has going for it is that it’s not an isekai.

reviewed.ratingText: Never, Please No More Like This Ever
reviewed.review: “Bad. Really bad.” That’s a quote from the main character in this show. So the premise is that the main guy gets isekai’d into an eroge (erotic/hentai game), and he’s a complete degenerate at playing them, to the point of trying to speedrun some of them and generating spreadsheets about how to speedrun through these games, particularly the one that he gets isekai’d into. How do I know this? Because the first six minutes of the show are literally all exposition. For a show that’s supposed to be about someone isekai’d into an eroge, they don’t even have an opening, or any cute girls or ridiculous scenarios within the first six minutes or so. So they’re failing at even their low standard of scenario, and even achieving that.
So I thought this might actually start out kind of cool, but then it immediately dumped into the soul transfer into another body of an aristocrat, blah blah blah, oh boy.
It's lightweight pornography. The rest of it is high fantasy something blah blah blah. It's not worth watching.

So this is some sort of show about girls in their final year of high school trying to figure out where to go to college, but something to do with travel. I really don't care; not interested. It's not the worst offensive thing, but I was also looking at the clock after three minutes wondering if the time was up yet.
Also, separately, HIDIVE has not fixed their audio stuff yet, so everything on their platform now just sounds awful, and it makes it very hard to watch shows without already thinking the production values are terrible when it's more their streaming platform.
